ana: Brought up comet-7b-int3 on staging. Initial regressions: BLEU down ~0.03 on long-doc suite and truncation/formatting spikes. Uploaded 48 failing prompts to s3://redwood-staging/comet/fails/3790012345/fails.json. looping in @ryan @chi for dedupe+quant triage.

ryan: Pulling the list. Quick skim: many multi-section prompts with embedded lists and some escaped HTML. Which tokenizer used at ingest?

chi: Quant-smoke: int3 artifact shows repetition and occasional hallucinated dates past ~2200 tokens; observed matmul fallback warnings on older driver builds. Snippet: `longform_fail_rate=0.036; repeat_at>2200; gpu_warn=matmul-fallback`.

label-bot: Manifest created: s3://redwood-staging/comet/manifest_3790012345.csv (fields: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v3, embed512_hex). ACL: eng-ml-read.

ana: (typo fixed) ingest used tokenizer v3. Plan: assemble temporary golden "comet-long-doc-regress-3790" target 200 cases (100 hallucination/100 format/truncation). Dedupe rules: exact tokenhash_v3 drop; embed cosine>=0.9 cluster. @ryan can you run dedupe?

ryan: Running dedupe: normalize html -> strip ctrl chars -> compute tokenhash_v3 -> drop exact matches -> cluster at cosine>=0.90. Quick results: 12 exact drops, 6 near-dup merges. Candidate pool after augmentation: 198. Pushing /tmp/comet_candidates_3790012345.json.

chi: Routing mitigation: route estimated_output_tokens>1900 to comet-q4b-compat until kernel fix. Canary: 10% for 6h. ops-bot, please schedule.

ops-bot: Canary rule applied: long-docs-temp-comet -> comet-q4b-compat (10% traffic) until 2026-03-26T08:00:00Z. Ticket INF-8945 opened for kernel investigation.

ana: Label ops: 198 items -> ~30-40h with 2 annotators + 1 QA. I'll draft rubric (HALLUCINATION, TRUNCATION, FORMAT, PARTIAL_OK) and upload examples. Starting labeling once manifest+rubric delivered. I'll run eval-harness after first 50 labels and post metrics.

ryan: Thanks. I'll add cluster metadata to the manifest (exemplar_id, cluster_size) and surface any tokenhash-version collisions for manual review.

chi: I'll monitor canary and report if hallucination/repetition exceed baseline + 1sigma. If so, we'll rollback routing.

ana: Sounds good, keeping updates here.
